comments.content: [medium] This `logger.exception` call duplicates the exception text: the message is built with a format specifier containing the exception string, yet `logger.exception` already appends the full exception details on its own. Please drop the `: %s` placeholder together with the `str(e)` argument so nothing gets logged twice.

[low] When logging this failure, consider including enough context (such as the name or role of the connector that raised the error) so operators can tell which underlying path failed in a multi-connector setup.

[low] If the intent is to isolate faults so one broken connector does not disrupt the others, it may be worth adding a focused unit test that forces one connector to raise and asserts the remaining connectors are still consulted as usual.
